title: Technical Recruiter
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Our Talent team is looking for an experienced and discerning technical recruiter to help build Linear’s next generation of engineering talent. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who sees recruiting as a craft.

Your primary focus will be growing our engineering team in North America. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership and our existing recruiters across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and emerging technical roles. You’ll own the full search, from mapping talent markets and activating networks through assessment, work trial support, and close.

Linear engineers tend to combine technical depth with product judgment, craftsmanship, and significant ownership. Finding them requires more than matching resumes to requirements. We’re looking for someone who can recognize these qualities, reach candidates with precision, and continually sharpen their judgment through close partnership with our team. All recruiters at Linear are generalists and may support other functions as company priorities evolve, but engineering will be the primary focus of this role.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North American (Eastern time zone), with a strong preference for the New York City area. Being in New York enables closer partnership with our growing local team, candidate events, and optional in-person support during work trials. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

- Partner directly with engineering leaders to understand their teams, develop hiring strategies, and own searches across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and other technical areas

- Build consistent, high-quality pipeline through talent mapping, direct sourcing, referrals, and long-term relationship development

- Identify engineers with strong technical foundations, product judgment, craftsmanship, and evidence of operating with significant ownership

- Conduct in-depth recruiter assessments covering technical fluency, ownership, product sensibility, motivations, and alignment with Linear’s working environment

- Maintain momentum through transparent communication, fast feedback loops, and clear ownership at every stage

- Use funnel data, candidate feedback, and hiring outcomes to improve sourcing strategies and pre-work trial calibration

- Maintain accurate, useful data in Ashby and ensure hiring partners have clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, and next steps

- Contribute to how our small Talent team works, while remaining adaptable enough to support other functions as company needs evolve

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, including hiring senior engineers at high-growth startups or product-led technology companies

- Exceptional sourcing ability, with evidence of turning research, networks, referrals, and thoughtful outreach into qualified candidate relationships

- Strong judgment about technical talent, product orientation, ownership, and the environments in which candidates are likely to perform best

- The ability to build credibility with highly sought-after engineers and represent Linear’s opportunity with clarity and candor

title: Entry Level Proposal Writer (Part Time, Remote)
description:
SJS Executives, LLC (SJS) of Virginia Beach, an SBA-certified Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), is seeking a part-time, remote technical writer to assist composition and formatting quotes and proposals that maximize the chances of the company winning contract work that is set aside for SDVOSBs.

This is an excellent opportunity for a student looking to build experience in technical writing while working in a flexible, part-time role. The ideal candidate is an excellent writer who enjoys researching new topics, has exceptional command of the English language, and can communicate technical information in a way that is easy to understand.

Pay for this position is $20.00 per hour. The position is expected to average 10 hours per week, with a flexible work schedule designed to accommodate the employee's class commitments.

The federal quotes and proposals that SJS submits to the government are primarily small to moderate size, such that one writer can generate/edit the entire response without a bids and proposals team. title: Product & Operations

title: Director of Partnerships
description:
About Us

We're building the intelligence layer for the home: ambient, proactive, and built into a family of devices, a central hub, accessories, and the software that ties them together. We’re a Series A startup backed by a tier-1 VC & technology partners, with an ex-unicorn founder. Early team, moving fast.

 

The Role

We're looking for a deal-maker who can build the partnerships and supply relationships that turn great hardware into a real business. This is a rare seat: you'll own both sides of our external commercial relationships, the brands and platforms we integrate and go to market with, and the manufacturing and component partners who build us, and you'll work directly with the CEO to structure and close the deals that matter. You are the person who makes deals happen. On one side, you'll build the ecosystem and commercial partnerships that put our product in front of consumers and make it work seamlessly in their homes. On the other, you'll partner with the CEO on the supply and manufacturing relationships that bring the hardware to life. Your common thread across both is the ability to find, structure, negotiate, and paper a deal, and to do it with the speed and judgment an early-stage company lives or dies on.

 

What You'll Do

- Own the partnership pipeline end to end. Identify, prioritize, and land partnerships across consumer brands, smart-home and audio ecosystems, and software platforms, from first conversation to signed agreement.

- Run the supply and manufacturing relationships. Work alongside the CEO and engineering on ODM, component, and supplier deals, negotiating terms, managing the relationships, and keeping us moving toward testable product fast.

- Write and own the contracts. Draft, structure, and negotiate term sheets, partnership agreements, supply agreements, and NDAs. Partner with the CEO and counsel to get them closed cleanly.

- Be the connective tissue. Translate between commercial partners, suppliers, engineering, and leadership so deals reflect what the product actually needs and what the business can commit to.

- Build the function. You'll start as an individual deal-maker and define how partnerships and BD scale as we grow.

 

You

- Consumer hardware native. You've done partnerships or business development inside consumer electronics, you understand the ecosystem, the players, the integration and distribution dynamics, and the realities of building physical product through partners.

- A closer, not just a connector. You're measured by signed deals, not meetings. You know how to move a relationship from interest to contract, and you've structured agreements that held up.

- Comfortable on both sides of the table. You can run a co-marketing or platform-integration conversation in the morning and a component or ODM negotiation in the afternoon, and you're credible in both rooms.

- Contract-fluent. You can read, redline, and draft commercial agreements yourself. You don't need a lawyer to start the document, you bring counsel in to finish it.

- Low ego, high ownership. No deal is too small and no follow-up beneath you. You operate with total discretion around sensitive commercial, financial, and partner information.

- Fast and founder-paced. You thrive working shoulder-to-shoulder with a CEO, you make calls with incomplete information, and you don't need a large org around you to be effective.

 

Qualifications

- 6+ years in business development, partnerships, or commercial roles, with meaningful time inside consumer hardware / consumer electronics.

- A demonstrable track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing partnership and/or supply agreements.

- Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts.

- Strong working knowledge of the consumer hardware landscape, brands, platforms, ecosystems, and the manufacturing/supply chain that supports them.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE ROLE

9fin's buy-side clients are the capital behind the credit markets. Credit funds, CLO managers, private credit platforms, and distressed investors run research, underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and relative value workflows that are deep and specialised. They are actively excited about what AI can unlock. Our job is to make that potential real inside their investment teams.

The Forward Deployed Investor is the person who does it. You are a domain expert who has done the work yourself, and you can credibly sit across the table from a portfolio manager, a private credit underwriter, or a distressed analyst and say: "Here is how this changes the way you invest."

You will work with 9fin's most strategic buy-side clients, drive deep adoption of our existing AI capabilities across the investment process, and become a critical voice in shaping what we build next. - Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

As a Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing technical projects and ensuring they are successfully delivered with strong results and real impact. Your work will include planning, coordinating, researching, organizing, and driving projects that bridge engineering, product, and business goals. Thriving in our dynamic, fast-paced environment requires not only monitoring progress but actively engaging in every stage of the project lifecycle-from initial scoping through execution and continuous improvement. •

•
Deliver Excellence: Cross the finish line with projects that not only meet the brief but also set new standards of excellence. Your commitment to quality and results will not just complete tasks but will carve out new benchmarks for success.

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. title: AI Tutor - Italian
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
As an AI Tutor specialized in multilingual audio capabilities, you will contribute to xAI's mission by training and refining Grok to excel in voice interactions, speech recognition, and auditory experiences across diverse languages, accents, and cultural contexts. Your work will focus on curating and annotating high-quality audio data to enhance Grok's global accessibility, enabling natural spoken interactions for users worldwide, bridging language barriers through accurate speech processing, and improving the AI's handling of multilingual audio nuances.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.

• Support the delivery of high-quality curated audio data that ensures clear, natural spoken output, accurate representation of linguistic and prosodic details (such as intonation, rhythm, and accent), and professional audio standards.

• Collaborate with technical staff to develop tasks that improve AI's ability to handle speech modulation, accent variation, noise in real-world recordings, and multilingual audio processing.

• Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Native proficiency in Italian with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.

• Proficiency in English (minimum B2 level) with clear, natural vocal delivery and pronunciation suitable for audio recording purposes.

• Strong auditory perception to identify nuances in speech, accents, pronunciation, intonation, and audio quality across languages.

• Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.

• Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.

• Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.

• Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, analytical, detail-oriented, and organizational skills, with the ability to articulate audio-related feedback effectively.

• Commitment to developing AI that masters sophisticated multilingual audio capabilities.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Demonstration of exceptional attention to linguistic nuance, auditory detail, and data quality beyond standard transcription work.

• Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.

• Strong command of advanced transcription and annotation practices, including handling disfluencies, accents, and prosodic features (intonation, stress, rhythm, emotion, etc) with high consistency and accuracy.

• Background in linguistics (e.g., phonetics, phonology, sociolinguistics), speech sciences, cognitive science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated ability to analyze accent variation, pronunciation differences, and multilingual speech patterns.

We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

title: Senior Software Engineer

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

• Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.

• Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.

• Develop deep PostgreSQL expertise by improving queries and schemas as the data behind vulnerability management continues to grow.

• Collaborate directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners on decisions within your scope.

• Contribute to technical plans and design discussions, and support other engineers through reviews, pairing, and clear documentation.

• Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.

• Contribute to GitLab's move toward modular services as the team establishes these patterns for GitLab Security.

 

What you’ll bring

• Professional backend engineering experience delivering production features and components at scale, with clear ownership of outcomes rather than tasks.

• Hands-on PostgreSQL experience, including query profiling and optimization, indexing, and schema design decisions, with an interest in growing into a domain expert.

Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our industry-leading products, services, and support to accelerate digital transformation and deliver measurable business outcomes. At Extreme Networks, we believe in teamwork, transparency, candor, curiosity, ownership, and inclusion as the foundation of our success.

The Partner Readiness Specialist serves as the bridge between Channel Sales, Systems Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services, Revenue Enablement, and Partner Organizations across Asia Pacific.

title: Senior Data Engineer - GTM

description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data team and own the reliability of the data our GTM stakeholders depend on. This is a full-stack role: you'll build and maintain the pipelines, transformations, and data models that turn CRM, marketing, and product usage data into the reporting and forecasting infrastructure that Sales, Marketing, and RevOps run on.

You'll work closely with GTM stakeholders to understand how metrics are used and make sure they're right, not just build to spec. Reporting to the Data team's engineering lead, you'll have full ownership over your area, set technical direction, and help raise the bar for how the team builds GTM data infrastructure.

If you want your work to directly shape how the business understands its pipeline, revenue, and go-to-market performance, we'd love to hear from you.

• Own pipelines that bring GTM source systems, including CRM, marketing automation, outbound tooling, and product usage, into the warehouse reliably.

• Diagnose and resolve data quality and freshness issues at the source, not just downstream.

• Design and maintain dbt models that turn raw GTM data into clean, trusted datasets, including pipeline, revenue, attribution, and funnel metrics.

• Set testing and documentation standards so models are trustworthy and easy for others to extend.

• Build datasets and semantic models that power the dashboards and reports Sales, Marketing, and RevOps leadership run on.

• Reduce reliance on one-off requests by designing for self-service.

• Work with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps leaders to understand what they need from the data and why, and push back when the ask doesn't match the underlying question.

• Bring enough context on how the business runs its GTM motion that you can spot bad metrics before they ship.

• Build pipeline and transformation code to a high engineering bar, and hold others to it through code review.

• Form and advocate for a point of view on GTM data modeling and pipeline design.

• Mentor other engineers and help set technical standards for the team.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience writing production-grade, testable code, not just scripts for one-off analysis

description:

OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.

About the Role

As a member of our AI Product Counsel team, you will lead legal compliance initiatives for global online safety, platform, and AI regulations, including the UK Online Safety Act, EU Digital Services Act, EU AI Act, and similar emerging frameworks. You will partner closely with Product, Policy, Safety, Engineering, Security, Operations, and other teams to translate complex regulatory requirements into scalable, practical compliance solutions.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Serve as the primary legal expert on the Online Safety Act, Digital Services Act, EU AI Act, and related global AI, platform, and online safety regulations.

- Lead the design and implementation of scalable compliance programs, governance frameworks, controls, and operating processes.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Safety, Policy, Operations, and Security teams to translate regulatory obligations into practical product and operational requirements.

- Monitor emerging regulations and enforcement trends, anticipate their impact, and help shape OpenAI’s compliance strategy.

- Develop repeatable processes, playbooks, escalation paths, and decision frameworks that enable teams to move quickly while managing risk responsibly.

- Support engagement with regulators, external counsel, industry groups, and other stakeholders as needed.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Have 10+ years of experience with a mix of in-house or technology-focused law firm roles.

- Have deep expertise in the UK Online Safety Act, EU Digital Services Act, EU AI Act, and similar global regulatory frameworks.

- Have experience building or leading scalable legal compliance programs in a fast-moving technology environment.

- Can translate complex legal requirements into practical product, technical, and operational guidance.

- Build cross-functional relationships and communication styles that resonate with teams to balance risk-taking with responsible development.

- Demonstrate strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating in ambiguous and rapidly evolving regulatory environments.

- Have a JD and license or qualification to practice in CA.

description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate , we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate ’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.
Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.
At Cogstate , we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.
About the Clinician Network
By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.
Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter , which shares updates and upcoming openings.
About the Role
Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.
Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.
*These are contract position.
*They are fully remote.
*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Spanish Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities
Central Rating

• Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.

• Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.

• Scoring completed scale administrations.

• Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

• Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.

• Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

• MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)

• Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment

• Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings

• Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations

• Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery

• Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Ex

About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.

title: Operations Lead
description:
About Arbor Neuroscience 
(formerly Forest Neurotech)
Arbor is a nonprofit research organization working on one of the hardest open problems in clinical neuroscience: how to change brain circuits by design.
Millions of people with depression, chronic pain, and other brain disorders have no treatment that works. Modulating activity in the brain circuits underlying their symptoms - with electrical stimulation, focused ultrasound, or magnetic stimulation - can work spectacularly well. But it doesn't work reliably, and we can't predict who it will help.
That's what Arbor aims to fix. The starting point is a new class of experiment: intervene, measure how the circuit responds, track the symptom, and repeat in the same individual over months. We’re building the necessary experimental platform. It currently includes the Forest 1 ultrasound system, which works like a wearable functional MRI, but with higher resolution. The system images activity across large brain volumes, including deep brain structures, and will soon stimulate as well. We are also adding electrode-based interfaces in animal studies. From these data, we'll build models to make neuromodulation predictable.
Arbor is a Focused Research Organization within the Convergent Research family, and the new name for Forest Neurotech. We're a mission-focused nonprofit, doing multidisciplinary translational work that doesn't fit in a lab or on a company roadmap. We have the funding to run the first phase, and we're a small team - the people we hire now will shape what Arbor becomes.

• Monitor product and video comments for customer questions, complaints, or escalations

• Check the Shop Health dashboard daily for violations, warnings, or Late Dispatch Rate (LDR) increases

Weekly Operations

• Review GMV Max campaign performance (cost, orders, CPA, ROI) and adjust target ROI as needed

• Audit GMV Max creative assets and exclude under-performing videos

• Review inventory levels and initiate restock for SKU

title: Internal Communications Lead
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create connection and belonging. The company was born with a creative spirit, much like the environment at the Rhode Island School of Design where Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia - two of its co-founders - went to college together. This creative spirit is one of the defining parts of Airbnb's culture.

Our Internal Communications team aims to build a strong and enduring culture by connecting more than 8,000 employees around the world to Airbnb's mission, community, and core values through storytelling and shared experiences. Our charter is simple and demanding: share high-quality, concise, relevant communications that inform and inspire.

The Difference You Will Make:

We are seeking an experienced communicator who is, first and foremost, an outstanding writer, and who can apply that craft to some of the most technical and consequential work happening at the company. The ideal candidate takes an entrepreneurial approach, both setting high-level direction and getting hands-on with tactics. You proactively influence, drive for clarity, and keep an eye on the details. You are an avid researcher and messaging strategist. And you’ll bring your skills to bear in a fast-moving environment involving multiple projects, deadlines, and personalities.

Our technology organization and its leadership team are evolving rapidly, with a growing volume of executive content. You will absorb complex material, help decide what matters, and turn it into moments and messages employees remember. You will be the internal communications partner to a set of VP-level leaders, with a particular focus on AI and data science. You will also help raise the editorial bar across the team as a trusted creator and reviewer for our company-wide channels. You will set and steward our internal voice and style, and contribute to the editorial direction of our practice.

A Typical Day: 

• Act as a strategic partner to your client leaders, providing counsel, feedback, and presentation coaching, and collaborating primarily during Pacific Time core hours.

• Develop quality executive materials: leader-voice Slack posts and email notes, thought leadership, all-hands narratives, org change communications, and short-form scripts with a heavy emphasis on emerging technology topics.

• Translate deeply technical work into compelling messages for both technical and non-technical employee audiences.

• Shape and align functional narratives to broader company priorities, so that Tech's story connects to where Airbnb is going.

• Own the design and production of high-impact connection moments for your client orgs (all-hands, forums, leadership offsites), including defining the narrative, building presentations, and coaching presenters.

• Serve as a trusted editor for the wider team, strengthening channel standards, shaping how we plan and measure content, and helping quality scale beyond any one reviewer.

• Lead or support change management, crisis communications, and special projects.

Your Expertise:

• 10+ years in strategic internal communications, editorial, or journalism, with a relevant degree (Journalism, Communications, PR, or related field) and a track record of producing work to a consistently high standard.

• Exceptional writer and editor above all else (creative, concise, and hyper-clear) able to take a dense or messy draft and make it sing under deadline.

• Demonstrated fluency with AI and other technical subject matter, with genuine curiosity about product development and how things work.

• Proven counselor to s

title: Link Organic Social Lead
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The team brings Link’s brand and product stories to life through compelling, platform-native organic social content. Working closely with Brand, Creative, and agency partners, we turn strong ideas into high-quality storytelling that informs and engages audiences. The team also tests new creative approaches, uses performance and community insights to refine what works, and shares learnings across the organization.

What you’ll do

Brand extension into organic social 

• Steward Link’s brand promise, brand voice and tone and creative standards for the organic social channels (in particular, Instagram, TikTok, and X); you're the internal authority on what on-brand looks like within the organic channel working in close partnership with our head of brand internally 

• Translate Link’s broader brand positioning into social-specific strategies and briefing frameworks the agency can work from with clear guardrails

• Evaluate and pressure-test agency-originated ideas for brand integrity before they get produced; catch what's off and redirect with specificity.

• Partner with our Head of Brand to ensure social is a genuine expression of brand health, a testing ground, and a helpful input to shape the evolution of our brand over time based on learnings.

Platform Strategy & Channel Direction

• Evolve platform-specific strategies with clear rationale: which channels we're on, what role each plays, what "winning" looks and feels like on each

• Bring platform fluency to evaluate whether agency ideas are actually native to each channel, knowing the difference between a post that was adapted for TikTok and one that was built for it

• Guide the agency on format choices, creative approaches, and content types per platform; your direction should make their output sharper

• Stay ahead of platform shifts; be the internal authority on what's changing and what it means for our creative approach and channel mix

Agency Direction & Partnership Management

• Own the agency relationship day-to-day: brief quality, feedback quality, creative reviews, and the overall standard of the work coming out of the partnership

• Write and refine briefs that give the agency enough strategic and creative direction to produce strong first drafts 

• Establish a review and feedback cadence that's efficient and that makes the agency's work measurably better over time; you're their best creative partner

• Manage agency output against brand standards, platform performance expectations, and business priorities

• Own the stakeholder approval process.  Map who needs to weigh in at each stage, build the workflows that move content through Legal, Compliance, Brand, and leadership review without killing creative momentum, and get smarter about how to frame work to earn fast alignment.

Editorial Oversight & Content Strategy

• Own the editorial calendar strategy - priorities, themes, moments, and content types - even when the agency is driving the calendar mechanics

• Review and approve content before it publishes with a dual lens: is it on-brand and is it built to perform

• Over time as the channel content matures, ensure the content mix reflects a coherent strategy

Community & Engagement Strategy

• Own the escalation layer: anything sensitive, high-stakes, or genuinely ambiguous comes to you before it goes out

• Surface community signals: what's resonating, what's creating friction, what people are

At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

- Identify and proactively flag dependencies with adjacent product teams before they become delivery risks

This leader owns the regulatory function end-to-end; shaping submission strategy, maintaining agency relationships, and ensuring compliance across all stages of the product lifecycle.

• Provide strategic and operational guidance to project teams to ensure regulatory submissions and compliance activities support corporate objectives.

• Successful experience with NDA submissions and major health authority interactions; MAA experience strongly preferred. Experience with small molecules and cardiometabolic diseases is preferred.

• Proven track record leading regulatory strategy for lifecycle expansion, working closely with Clinical Development on programs, expedited pathways, and global launch readiness.
